subject: Adding Level 2 Predictors to Multilevel Model

messages.author: fde350c95c8183c7
messages.subject: Adding Level 2 Predictors to Multilevel Model
parts:
Hello there,

I am analyzing a dataset that utilizing time sampling to predict loneliness. I am struggling to add control variables at level 1 in order to see how age may predict momentary affect in addition to person-level affect. All variable on level 1 are time-varying, while those on level 2 are person-level variables.

modelwithage<- '
level : 1
  SA_Last ~ a1*NA_First
  SIDay2 ~ a2*SA_Last
  LNDay3 ~ a3*SIDay2
  LNDay3 ~ c_1*NA_First
  indirect1 := a1*a2*a3
  total1 := c_1 + indirect1
Level : 2
  SA_Last_mean ~ a_1*NA_First_mean + age 
  SI_Day2_mean ~ a_2*SA_Last_mean  + age 
  LNDay3_mean ~ a_3*SI_Day2_mean  + age 
  LNDay3_mean ~ c_2*NA_First_mean
  indirect2 := a_1*a_2*a_3
  total2 := c_2 + indirect2
'
I would like to control for age in the time-varying level of the model, but in trying to do so get the following error: Error in lav_fit_measures(object = object, fit.measures = fit.measures,  : lavaan ERROR: fit measures not available if model did not converge.
How then do I control for age at this level?

Thank you!

Meagan

messages.author: 54c05e928c45ac6c
messages.subject: Re: Adding Level 2 Predictors to Multilevel Model
parts: Your model didn't converge for any number of reasons. I advise starting with a simple model to ensure convergence then adding complexity to identify the issue. Hard for anyone to help here without a minimal working example since non-convergence can have many causes.
